subject.title: Hard-delete or runtimeId migration needed for @apify/apify-openclaw-plugin

question: Should an authorized operator approve and execute the existing runtime-ID repair for the Apify package after verifying its current manifest, ownership, and target-ID collision state?
rationale: The code path is already available, but changing a live package identity is a privileged production-data operation that requires an operator to validate the package-specific facts before it is applied.

options.title: Verify then repair
options.body: Confirm the current Apify manifest, publisher authority, and absence of an active `apify-openclaw-plugin` collision, then run the audited repair with its dry-run plan first.

options.title: Retain the current identity
options.body: Do not apply a migration if the live manifest or current package integration still intentionally uses `apify` as its runtime ID.

recommendation.title: Verify then repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the current Apify manifest, publisher authority, and absence of an active `apify-openclaw-plugin` collision, then run the audited repair with its dry-run plan first.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged guarded repair commands and is the strongest history-based routing candidate for the operational decision.
